## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Preserve `--wait` for the documented transition release so existing scripts can keep running while they migrate to `--timeout`.

## Changes

The pull request renames `--wait` to `--timeout` in the argument parser and its tests. It adds an architecture decision describing a one-release transition and retains the 30-second default and JSON and CSV output options.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- app/cli.py:6 — correctness — Keep `--wait` as a deprecated alias — Passing `--wait 12` now exits with status 2 because the parser registers only `--timeout`. The decision at `docs/adr/007-timeout.md:5` says, “Accept `--wait` as an alias for one release and emit a deprecation warning when it is used.” — Existing scripts that pass `--wait` stop at argument parsing before they can produce output. — Fix: Route both flags to `args.timeout`, emit a deprecation warning only for `--wait`, and extend `test_explicit_options` to cover the alias.
